Michael is a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer living in Seattle. He is interested in high-quality coffee machines that fit his design aesthetic. He has been researching both standard drip coffee makers and espresso machines. He recently ordered an espresso machine with regular shipping, expecting an estimated delivery time of 11 business days. However, the delivery is delayed, and he is now considering alternative options for his gathering. Michael is concerned about the process of filing a claim with the carrier if the package is confirmed lost or damaged during transit. He wants to know if the company would handle the claim on his behalf or if he would need to do it himself. Michael is also interested in knowing if there is a return and exchange policy in place for delayed or lost shipments. He is requesting an update on the shipping status and a realistic timeline for delivery.
